_comment: Scan profiles. Every value is checked by src/scanprofile.py before use. Values follow docs/ZAP_NOTES.md (verified against ZAP 2.16.1). 'deep' is the scan we ran before profiles existed.

quick.description: Traditional spider with a short time cap, passive checks only. A few minutes; sends no attacks.

standard.description: Traditional spider, AJAX spider, then active scan at Low strength with duration limits.

deep.description: The reference scan: traditional spider, AJAX spider, passive wait, active scan at ZAP's default strength and threshold, no limits.
